cosmetic: The tab strip is scrolled so the first tab, "Chat", is cut off at the left edge. It looks like a horizontally scrollable strip, so the tab can still be reached.

In the pull request card's action row, the links "Why", "Open thread" and "Open task" are not consistently sized or aligned: "Open task" has larger text and different spacing than the other two links, and the outlined "Open on GitHub" button sits next to them.
The "Merge" button looks disabled and has low contrast against the card. This is probably intended because of the conflict, but it is still faint.
The pink link text is bright against the dark card and clashes slightly with the rest of the muted palette.
There is a large empty area below the "Recently merged" section. This is expected given how little content there is.
